proposed.explanation: Changdeokgung Palace is a secondary palace (built 1405), not the first major Joseon palace. Bulguksa Temple is a Buddhist temple (751 CE, Silla Dynasty), not a Joseon dynasty palace. Namdaemun is a city gate (1398), not a palace. Gyeongbokgung Palace is explicitly identified as the first major palace of Joseon Dynasty (1395–present) in Seoul, with north-south axis, ondol-heated chambers (Gangnyeongjeon), and site-integrated design.
